acquisitionOrdering.note: Temporary files outside the project were used only to verify upstream bytes after the user authorization; no package, lockfile, model, WASM resource, or product source was added to the project.

resources.name: U-2-Netp ONNX model
resources.verification: Exact HTTP ranges reconstructed to the official 4,574,861-byte release size. The SHA-256 was calculated over ordered ranges and the MD5 matches rembg's declared upstream value.

resources.name: ONNX Runtime Web/WASM
resources.verification: Official npm metadata matched an independently reconstructed 20,439,316-byte archive from ordered 65,536-byte HTTP ranges. SHA-1, SHA-512 SRI, SHA-256, tar listing, package version, and license all match.

independentNpmCacheReproduction.method: In each fresh temporary npm cache, read official npm dist metadata and run npm pack onnxruntime-web@1.20.1 with --ignore-scripts and --json. No project directory, dependency, lockfile, model, WASM resource, or product source was modified.
independentNpmCacheReproduction.result: Three fresh isolated npm-cache attempts read official metadata but did not produce a tarball that could complete explicit SHA-512/SHA-1 comparison, tar listing, package metadata, and size verification. The verbose attempt reached only npm registry metadata GET 200 responses before no verifiable tarball was available.

rangeAudit.result: The earlier 256KiB attempt had one short range. A subsequent serial 64KiB retry completed all 312 ranges at exact lengths and reconstructed the official archive.

independentNpmCacheReproduction.disposition: The earlier truncated response is rejected. The independently reconstructed 64KiB-range archive is approved after all official integrity and package checks.

packageSizeImpact.reason: Measured model plus verified runtime archive bytes; package metadata and license files add additional small overhead in Task 6.2.

nextRequiredAction: The verified resources are ready for Task 6.1 check-off, but activation of streamline Task 6.2 is blocked by missing task capsule and Integration owner. The existing integration-6.2.json belongs to integrate-routego-image-plugin and must not be reused. Create a matching streamline task capsule through the Controller before product mutation.

dispatchBlocker.requiredAction: Create or restore the committed streamline 6.2 task capsule and activate an Integration apply owner using the existing thread/workspace policy before dispatch.
